newsitem.title: USA: Applied Graphics signs multi-year GM deal.
newsitem.headline: Applied Graphics signs multi-year GM deal.

text.p: Applied Graphics Technologies Inc said Friday it had signed a contract to supply digital prepress production services and provide distribution and warehousing of radio and television commercials for General Motors Corp.

Under the contract, which runs through August 2000, Applied Graphics will provide substantially all of the services that GM, its seven vehicle marketing divisions and its dealer networks require in these areas.
Applied Graphics said it would provide GM with a more efficient way to handle the production of printed materials and distribution of radio and television commercials.
It said it would also build a single, comprehensive database using its Digital Link System for all of GM media content.
It will act as GM's primary content manager, and will develop a central repository of digital content.
